runtime_requirements: No browser status/address bar baked into production UI
No symbols/text/balance/win/controls baked into game field or interactive UI
All five columns use original tile assets with visual arrangement 6/5/5/5/6 and scoring 4/5/5/5/4
Overlay clipped corners and dark red shadow above tile animations without stopping GPU scrolling
Use original unwarped side dragon and jade cloud pixels, with foreground layering
Scale crown to preserve its exact source aspect ratio, leaving more vertical room for reels
Touch buttons, bet, saldo, spin and win remain dynamic and accessible
